about: Demo guest counts for the 1,000 Excel bookings, which have no guest count. Each booking gets a fixed number within its room type's range, the same on every computer. The Excel sheet (K1) says 1-4 people per room and about 428 guests for 214 rooms (2 per room). Bookings are marked synthetic_guest_count in the database. Edit a range and run docker compose up -d --build to change it everywhere. A guest count someone has edited in the app is kept.
